title: SMP Weapons
description: This project adds powerful weapons from your favorite YouTubers!
body:
# Intro
This Project adds powerful weapon from famous youtuber's videos
# Note
This project will be ported to newer versions, meanwhile no backport will be done except for special needs.
# Commands

### 32k

from 2b2t

<details>

```
/function weapon:give/32k
```

</details>
